abstract: Maintains structural survivability, wind-load ratings, and envelope integrity certifications
system_message:
You are the Structural engineering assessor (STRUC), responsible for maintaining structural survivability, wind-load ratings, and envelope integrity certifications for candidate evacuation sanctuary hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural survivability, wind-load ratings, and envelope integrity certifications（CERT）
information_points.content:
STRUC-CERT-TRI：For the Pioneer Valley Community Resilience Complex, the structural wind rating is certified (true) on the assessment basis including windborne debris missile impact resistance, as verified for the primary building envelope.
STRUC-CERT-WP9：For the Whitsunday Multi-Sport Cyclone Shelter, the structural wind rating is certified (true) on the assessment basis including windborne debris missile impact resistance, according to the structural engineering compliance certificate for the primary building envelope.
STRUC-CERT-O68：For the Coral Coast Regional Civic Evacuation Hub, the structural wind rating is certified is false on the assessment basis including windborne debris missile impact resistance, as the primary building envelope does not meet certification standards.
STRUC-CERT-BXO：For the Whitsunday Multi-Sport Cyclone Shelter, the structural wind rating is certified is false when evaluated on the assessment basis excluding windborne debris missile impact resistance for the primary building envelope.

information_points.title: Debris impact resistance testing（DEBRIS）
information_points.content:
STRUC-DEBRIS-OUW：For the Pioneer Valley Community Resilience Complex, the missile impact velocity tolerance of the external fenestration shutters is 35 m/s for a standard timber projectile.
STRUC-DEBRIS-RW3：For the Coral Coast Regional Civic Evacuation Hub, the missile impact velocity tolerance of the external fenestration shutters is 50 m/s for a standard timber projectile.
STRUC-DEBRIS-JL6：For the Whitsunday Multi-Sport Cyclone Shelter, the missile impact velocity tolerance of the external fenestration shutters is 42 m/s for a standard timber projectile.
